title: bundle refuses and skips
description: User story under REQ-177 for DEFINE step 3 PR 8 (spec section 4 bundle row, section 11.7 US-17702). `rcf build bundle --next` refuses on an unfrozen tree (exit 4, message naming `rcf define readiness`); `--override "<reason>"` writes `freeze.override { reason, by, at }` and proceeds; on a non-empty delta the next-item compute skips re-execute FBS impacted by the delta with the reason and hands out the next unimpacted FBS; when every actionable FBS is impacted and no override is given the verb refuses with exit 4.
iWant: `rcf build bundle --next` to refuse without a freeze record, to accept a recorded override, to skip FBS impacted by a non-empty delta and hand out the next unimpacted one, and to refuse when every actionable item is impacted and no override is given
soThat: I cannot bundle a stale next item against an unfrozen tree, a hotfix path exists with a recorded reason, and the 0.29.0 output on a frozen tree with an empty delta is unchanged

acceptanceCriteria.description: [failure] given no freeze record, when rcf build bundle --next runs, then it exits 4 naming rcf define readiness.
[happy] given --override "hotfix", when bundle --next runs on an unfrozen tree, then freeze.override records reason, by and at and the bundle is produced.
[happy] given a delta impacting FBS-018, when bundle --next runs, then FBS-018 is skipped with the reason and the next unimpacted FBS is handed out.
[failure] given every actionable FBS impacted and no override, when bundle --next runs, then it exits 4.
[must-not] given a frozen tree with an empty delta, when bundle --next runs, then its output is unchanged from 0.29.0.
